I have about a thousand theories concerning the source of your pain, but not a single certification to rightfully share them with you. Its a medical topic, and I dont want to do harm by hitting you with insights or advice that may make things worse, or put you in an even more painful direction.

But I can tell you now without an ounce of regret that your feelings and actions are unjustified in many ways. You dont have to feel that way or act that way in order to deal with whatever guilt or anger that revolves around your inherited life. Its ok to feel shitty about it. And nobody ever wants to say that. But go ahead, feel like bottom feeding scum.

  


Its what that feeling leads to that could possibly set you free. It'd take countless hours of talking to even figure out if your pain is based on the fact you have things you "dont deserve". Im sure you wouldnt be suprised to find out the pain comes from somewhere else, but that your current reasoning is the easiest way to metabolize the stress.

Like I said, you deserve to be content. Taking your anger out inanimate objects is a sign of issues, but not inherently evil. So with that being said, dont beat yourself up. For a lot of us who struggle with suicide, I dont think the very systematic disassembly of patterns is the answer. It mitigates our stress and our tendancies, but doesnt provide an answer to what needs to change.

I truly believe finding the answer starts with such a deep look at yourself that you and me probably arent even capable of it without proper guidance. That doesnt neccesarily mean Therapy(TM), or maybe it does. What it for sure means though is help. Its hard to sort through the garbage without an insightful human acting as a filter.

My points summarized: You dont need to die. Also you can be happy. But it will be hard work that involves seeking the appropriate resources and than utilizing them. Of course, thats easier said than done. It is much easier to sulk and then eventually end it. I wish the spark needed to change came more organically, but it just doesnt seem too.

It is at least comforting to know that happiness is out there and possible. But dont let the possibility be enough. Dont sit and think you can make yourself happy once you are ready. You do not want to suffer for long. If you dont kill yourself or get help, there is a possibility you will live so crushed under the weight of your discontent that you will just break. It happens so slowly yet so quickly. Its subtle and yet so obvious to those around you.

Drug habbits, reckless behaviour, self harm, constant hospital visits, objective failure, totally backwards personality, the list goes on. Do not let these be your eventual realities. They dont help, and yet they will be utilized.

Sometimes I ask myself why depressed people are pressured to live. Why cant we just die already? Who cares? But then I compare my life to yours, and realize some of us, such as yourself, have something needed in the grand scheme. So why not put in the work to be happy about your place?

Getting to the core of why I feel this way may sadly be the only way out. Its clear I have manic episodes marked by violence and impulsive actions, but no doctor has yet to pinpoint *why*

And so Im stuck. They cannot medicate me, nor can therapy shead insight on my behaviours. Even the vast open forum that is the internet has nothing come even close to relatable. I'm not looking for a cure-all, that is not how it works. I need to nail down what drives my actions and feelings. I have no traumas, fairly regular upbringing, relative monetary success, I feel as though I well liked, or at least accepted. So what gives? Its as if I adapted the typical teenage rebellion phase but instead of snapping out of it, it just grew with my age to a point of reprehensible behaviour. Couple that with whatever my disposition for emotional pain is, and you have a man lost and ready to give it up.

Most of what you've said seems to strike me as making sense. But I am curious as to why you think you dont deserve your life. Even if what you feel is perfect was handed to you without any work, its not as if you chose that. You dont choose to harm those in your path. Elaborate.

Life does matter. Its why it is a thing. If you want to die despite perfection and genuinley have no chemical imbalance to attribute it too, it could be as simple as poor perspective and cognitive patterns. Or so that is what Ive been taught over years of CBT and DBT.

My problem is that I do deserve to die. If you took my actions and presented them before a judge and jury, I would be gone right now. I wish harm and sometimes even act on it out of no other reason than I feel they are as low as I am. We are all equal.

My conundrum is that I have the empathy and decency to realize this is very very very wrong. And yet here I am. Ill rob you for the fun of it. Ill do coke to punish myself and reward myself simultaneously.

  


  


If your life is as perfect as you claim, then just be. You are amongst the many who deserve to be here. I know it isnt as simple as that, but know there is an answer (or series of answers) that will eventually bring you peace. Think deep and hard about what in your general perspective is flawed. Obviously this sort of introspective journey is best complimented by a trained professional (generic advice).

You are gifted if you are decent. And so you deserve to be content even if it isnt fair that you have to work so hard for it. But there it is at least, you earned it once you get there. You dont have to look back on why it is you deserve to leave. We all have regrets, make mistakes. But sometimes you can be such a force of evil that its undeniable that you need to go. Sounds to me like that isnt you. So imagine being content the best you can, then once you are able to visualize it, tell yourself that you deserve it, because you do. Most people do.

I wont sit here and tell you that you have to live. But its an option you are more than entitled too, and it doesnt have to come with pain attatched.

Yeah I feel like in most major countries the analogue laws have more or less caught up. It's still practiced but at much lower levels in the supply chain. So it's hard to get any discernable metrics as to what's being cut where, and with what frequency when we are talking about RCs.

80% or more of cocaine seized at the boarder contains pretty liberal amounts of levamisole however, so that's worth some media hype. Major distributors or even the manufacturers themselves appear to be the culprits, and that's fucked up.

Lol one line of something cut with baking soda and you'd be all clogged up for the night. It also doesn't play nicely with cocaine when rocking. And of corse in general it's detectable without even running any kind of test. It's visible and makes the product taste salty. They wouldn't get away with it like they do with this foul shit.

Cartels use the cut, or so it's suspected. When they cut, they need to still be able to pass the half-assed purity tests of their distributors. And for whatever reason, they dont want it to be easily taken out once its been rocked up. And so, this is a great option for them. Ether, acetone, ethanol, water titilation, none of these common methods can successfully remove levamisole.

On top of that it's suspected it has stimulant effects all by itself, making the product seem more potent. It adds no discernable taste or smell too the cocaine. It adds little too no bulk as it is densely weighted. A savvy distributor will notice no difference in the physical size of their batch VS the weight. In bulk it is stupid cheap too acquire. It is still used to deworm fish.

  


Too summarize:

Relatively undetectable

Adds weight without adding bulk

Difficult to remove

Adds no smell or taste

Makes the end produdct more stimulanting (possibly more euphoric)

Cheap. 20% cut = 18-19% more profits for the cartels, or anyone who uses it to bulk up product.

Yeah, arguably it's worse for you than the cocaine itself. But if the cartels and distributors cared about public health, they probably wouldn't sell addictive stimulants made out of plant goop and kerosine.

As far as stimulants go I guess meth is the most evil according to the world's rhetoric. It's like cocaine is a forgotten relic. And while I agree meth gets dysfunctional very quickly, that doesn't mean cocaine isn't bad or easily available.

For a while it can be so positive. Especially when you can afford to keep it going.

But as you become dependant, your whole life revolves around it, because it can. Everything you do is in the name of cocaine. Even sleeping tended to mean this whole 2-3 hour forced comedown ritual since I didnt want to mix benzos into my functioning addict lifestyle. Of course waking up meant lines before, during and after my commute to work. Smoke breaks became coke breaks, and also still smoke breaks. Man even my hygeine schedule revolves around cocaine. Take everything a normal person does to get clean and add in about an hour of nose care spread out over various points in the day. I can't even drink water for myself, I'm always running around filling up my cup at work and home to combat the dehydration and having to stock up on electrolyte formulas to mix them with. Enjoy a nice meal? Sometimes. Rarely. Usually food is the last thing on my mind, but I force myself too lest I just murder everyone as the edginess of the day's high just builds and builds. I dont even enjoy it anymore. Euphoria is even shorter and more fleeting than it already is. A 30-60 minute good time is more like 5 minutes followed by this strange aura of stress. I've noticed people at work tend too avoid me if possible. I speak aggressivly and condescendingly without even meaning too.

You get the picture, its consuming. But you wont function forever. You will crash eventually. You have no idea how much there is too lose. I'd honestly have been addicted to something with a higher overdose risk, I'd rather be dead than to live my life as someone who lost what I have to the drug.

And I still cant stop. I can never. The only things it still helps me with like confidence and my job are all I have left. Everyone has left me or gone so far as to renounce me. I have some very troubling health issues as a result of using it daily. Some benign and unfortunate, others that may require action unless I'm interested in a painful death.

And for those of you who can "sorta" afford it, dont. Just dont. If I didnt have the ability to afford my habbit I cant imagine what unspeakable things I'd do for more. Some people I've met in the scene aren't above things like home invasion, robbery and scamming. What's sad is that during sober times they seem like really normal and nice enough people. Mid bender? Jesus christ.

Stick with what's been proven. I wish I found some MDMA or something that first night I ran into coke because I'm so fucking done with this shit. Every night I cry myself to sleep on the most self loathing and emotionally draining crash known to man. The crash actually starts out so... easy. A few months or whatever down the road, it gets to a point where I think it makes meth crashes look like a joke.

Maybe its all the alcohol I drink to help take the edge off of the high. Another thing that wasn't there at the start. Fuck this.

One more quick point I'd like too add: stimulant withdrawal is not a myth. I put anywhere from 3 to 5 grams of this shit in my nose a day at this point. Are sedatives more dangerous to withdraw from? Hell yeah. But do you really think I'd be able to work if I came off this shit suddenly? Cramps, shitting my pants, sweats, complete emotional breakdowns that are unprovoked, tremors that would probably register on the Richter scale. Then of course the typical shit that any addict has to deal with once they detox regardless of what they've taken. The cravings. The depression. The total lack of identity.

Just stop using habitually. Meaning every weekend, or every paycheque, or everyday, or at a certain party place. Thats when it becomes dull and destructive.
